description: This file defines a React component named DeploymentStatusBarChart that renders a themed, accessible bar chart showing deployment counts by status. It includes internal methods for rendering tooltips, labels, and handling user interactions, and imports several external libraries and utility functions.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A custom tooltip component for displaying deployment status details on hover.

methods.name: ValueLabel
methods.description: A component for rendering value labels above each bar in the chart.

methods.name: auditLogInteraction
methods.description: Logs user interactions such as bar clicks and legend clicks for auditing purposes.
